## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `abc9f1aa3d286375689d63d004f944f312194122`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed in seat by the dispatching skills seat (served tier read from `get_session` `last_served_model` this act, equal to the constant's value), on the PR diff (nine files under `docs/adr/`, +163/−6, two commits — the edit and a merge of `origin/main` `18cd410dc4`; `check-governed-merges --pr 23362`: `docs/adr/**`, Tier H, 169 changed lines), card #22978, the stage-8 landing (`66949b7729`) and the head's check-runs. The governed face is the ADR text; the judgment is whether each inserted note records the retirement the way AGENTS.md rule 13 asks and states only facts the tree carries. Written 2026-10-14T02:00Z.

### ① Derived judgments

- Form. Every one of the 440 diff lines is an insertion: the six `−` lines are the six `**Status**:` lines re-emitted with an appended `· **Amended** (2026-10-14, ADR-0131 …)` segment; `grep -cE '^[-+]#'` on the diff → 0, so no heading moves and no anchor another file cites changes (`Lint & Repo Gates` runs `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-links`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`). The three note forms are the corpus's own: the status-line `Amended` segment (ADR-0005, ADR-0029 precedents), `> **RETIRED 2026-10-13 (#15204 stage 8, by execution of ADR-0131 …)**` where a mechanism the record decided is gone (ADR-0006 v4 precedent), `> **Note (2026-10-14) — …**` where the decision stands and only the stored object is gone. No decision sentence is rewritten; each note says what stands ("D1 stands", "the renames and the word ban stand", "the constraint stands"). Correct under rule 13 — an amended status line on the old record, never a quiet reversal.
- Facts the notes state, read on `main` `18cd410dc4` in this act: stage 8 is `66949b7729` (2026-10-13, PR #23222); stage 7b `5c9bfb0d3f` deleted the position write-through and the row-only backfill (its subject says so); stage 6b-2 `c8a9783eca` is the "no seeder writes a `sys_permission_set` row" commit and `bootstrap-declared-permissions` has 0 paths on `main`; `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts` is still in the tree (the notes say "stays until #15204 stage 7a deletes it" — true today, and dated); `registerMutationProjector` is still called from `protocol.ts`, `security-catalog-echo.ts`, `service-automation`, `service-datasource` and the unwired projection module, so "the seam stays" is true; PR #23334 (`6d96721faa`) is the security-catalog echo serving metadata-door permission sets and positions, as the ADR-0094 notes say; `PositionSchema.permissionSets` is `z.array(SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema).optional()` (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts:106`) and `delegatable` is a key of the same schema, so "a position names its sets in its own definition" and "`sys_position.delegatable` left with its object" are true; ADR-0131 D10 is the per-table migration the notes defer the rows to (`0131…md:532`). Every cited fact holds.
- Population. `git grep -c -E 'sys_position|sys_permission_set|sys_capability' -- 'docs/adr/*.md'` on the head lists exactly the ten card numbers (eleven files), so the sweep is complete and no ADR outside the card names the four objects; `0057-system-data-lifecycle` has 0 hits (the positive control on the ERP 0057 counts 2) and is correctly left alone.
- ADR-0131 unchanged. Its D2/D3/D13 and §4 already read as retiring the four objects and its status line says execution state is carried by the epic #15193/#15204, not by the line — leaving it is the reading that keeps the decision record and the execution ledger apart (the dev's open question; the seat takes A).
- `Fixes #22978` is the body's only closing keyword (the body names #15194, #15204, #22900, #22975, #23222, #23302, #23334, #4671 with no closing verb); `Clause-②: no` is correct — no published surface, no spec path. `content/docs/**` and `packages/**` untouched, as the card requires.

### ② Semver level

None owed: no package ships `docs/adr/**` (the body's reading: 72 `package.json` files declare `files[]`, 72 ship `dist`, 0 ship `docs/adr`). `skip-changeset` is the seat's label, written after this review's docs-only reading; `Check Changeset` re-reads under it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag — the branch merged `origin/main` (`18cd410dc4`) before the gate run because `dispatch-gates` flagged a stale tree; the merge commit carries no conflict and the derived list was unchanged (19 commands). Accepted.
- Dev flag — ADR-0131 links carry no `#fragment` (all 25 existing links in the corpus are written that way; `check-adr-links` strips fragments). Accepted; the dispatch's `#…` spelling was a suggestion.
- Dev flag — `RETIRED` headings carry the execution date (2026-10-13) and `Amended` / `Note` headings the authoring date (2026-10-14), following ADR-0006 v4's form. Accepted and consistent.
- Dev flag — `check:doc-formula-expressions` NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, `@objectstack/formula` not built; docs-only diff): `Lint & Repo Gates` on this head runs it. Accepted.
- Open question (should ADR-0131's status line also record that C3 stage 8 executed): **A** — leave it; the nine amended ADRs and the epic carry the execution record, and the line's own text says so. Seat decision; the 速读 shows the maintainer the alternative in one line.
- Out of scope: none to file; the "7a deletes the module" clause is dated and needs no edit when #22975 lands.

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #23362 · head `abc9f1aa3d` · Tier H(`docs/adr/**`)

skills 席 1(`session_013zGKMG1cRedVzWtqGGGZW9`,huangyiirene),写于 2026-10-14T02:01Z。席内契约复核 PASS 记录在本 PR,ACCEPT 在卡 #22978;本 PR 保持 draft,⛔ 席位不翻 ready、不入队。

### 改了什么

9 份 ADR 提到了岗位、权限集、岗位-权限集绑定、能力这四个「目录行对象」,或提到了 ADR-0094 的权限集投影机制;#15204 第 8 阶段(`66949b7729`,10 月 13 日合并)已把它们从系统里摘除,但这些 ADR 还把它们写成在用的数据表。本 PR 按 AGENTS.md 第 13 条在原 ADR 上留修订记录:状态行追加一段 `Amended (2026-10-14, ADR-0131 D3/D13 …)`,受影响的章节下各加一段带日期的说明(机制本身被退役的写 `RETIRED 2026-10-13 (#15204 stage 8 …)`,决定仍成立、只是所指的表没了的写 `Note (2026-10-14)`)。全部是插入(+163/−6,减的 6 行是状态行原地加长),标题一个没动,其他文件引用这些 ADR 的锚点不受影响。ADR-0131(做出退役决定的那份)和 ADR-0057 数据生命周期(未提到这四个对象)没改。

### 为什么改

不留记录,人和 AI 读旧 ADR 会以为这些表还在,照着写出错误的代码或元数据;ADR 的约定是「被后来决定退役的内容,在原记录上留修订,不改写决定」。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 只改文档,不碰任何发布的包,运行时零影响;回滚 = revert 本 PR(两个 commit)。
- 风险只有「说明里的事实写错」一种:席位在 `main` 上逐条核过——第 8 阶段提交、7b(`5c9bfb0d3f`)删了岗位写透与回填、6b-2(`c8a9783eca`)删了权限集播种器、投影模块仍在树上等 7a(#22975)删、`registerMutationProjector` 接缝仍被五个模块调用、`PositionSchema.permissionSets` 与 `delegatable` 在 spec 里、D10 迁移存在。7a 落地后「模块仍在树上」变成历史描述,但说明带了日期,不误导。

### 席位意见

同意落地。① 形式正确:只增不改、不动标题、三种写法都是语料库里已有的先例;② 事实全部对得上树;③ dev 的开放问题「ADR-0131 状态行要不要也记一笔第 8 阶段已执行」,席位取 A(不记):ADR-0131 自己的 D2/D3/D13 与 §4 本来就写着退役,它的状态行写明执行进度由 epic(#15193/#15204)记录,九份被修订的 ADR 已承担记录;若你想让执行可见于记录本身,B 是在同一 PR 的状态行上加一段,一行的事,在该行留评即可。

### 你要做的

一个动作:对本 PR **Approve**(`docs/adr/**` 是 Tier H,需要你一次授权批准;批准后席位经中继落地)。
